Our reception and care navigation team have been fully trained to complete the online triage with patients over the phone or in person at the front desk, using our practice iPads where needed. No patient should feel excluded from accessing care because of digital barriers.

We have reviewed your case and can see that an appointment has been arranged for you with a clinician. We recognise, however, that adjusting to a new system can be challenging, especially for patients living with long‑term conditions or disabilities.

The system has now been in place for two months, and while most patients are benefiting from shorter waits and no longer need to queue on the phone, we recognise that a small number of patients are still experiencing difficulties. Your feedback is extremely valuable in helping us understand these impacts, and we are actively reviewing and refining our processes as part of our full change management programme.

If you would like us to discuss this further to explore reasonable adjustments, please contact the surgery. We are committed to ensuring all patients can access safe and appropriate care.
